'''DarthVader,AOE HuntDownAndDuelTheJedi PLAYERS PRECONSTRUCT 3''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[DarthVader,AOE]]
* '''Published:''' 10 January 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Scenario
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 HD DarthVader,AOE DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck is for classic format games and will be especially fun to play against Rescue The Princess (Preconstruct #4)

The published list has 55 cards.

== Strategy ==

Created by the members of GPN as the typical (and very powerful) example of a standard Hunt Down and Destroy The Jedi deck.
Yes, it does give me a better rating... but I don't abuse my power (or really make any use of it at all). Just think of me as a moderator to this specific deck forum.
It's really nothing I planned. As a matter of fact, I expected the decks to be weak but fun and probably get bad ratings.
One more point: Since I created the format for the design of these decks- does it really hurt for me to get good feedback for them?
